schema_text:
Table `customers`: (`customerId` varchar(50), `name` varchar(100), `email` varchar(100), `loyaltyPoints` int(11), `created_at` timestamp, `updated_at` timestamp)
Table `employees`: (`empId` varchar(50), `cashierName` varchar(100), `location_id` int(11), `created_at` timestamp, `updated_at` timestamp)
Table `inventory_logs`: (`log_id` int(11), `itemCode` varchar(50), `location_id` int(11), `change_qty` decimal(12,3), `reason` varchar(100), `log_date` date, `log_time` time, `created_at` timestamp)
Table `invoice_items`: (`id` int(11), `invoiceNumber` varchar(50), `itemCode` varchar(50), `qty` decimal(12,3), `itemPrice` decimal(12,2), `itemCost` decimal(12,2), `discount` decimal(12,2), `taxValue` decimal(12,2), `itemRemark` text, `itemsDataList` text, `invoiceLineDiscountList` text, `invoiceItemAddonList` text)
Table `invoices`: (`invoiceNumber` varchar(50), `mainInvoiceNumber` varchar(50), `invoiceCentralizeId` varchar(50), `uniqueId` varchar(100), `reference` varchar(100), `kotNumber` varchar(50), `orderNumber` varchar(50), `licenceKey` varchar(100), `customerId` varchar(50), `customerCash` decimal(12,2), `customerBalance` decimal(12,2), `invoiceCustomerSignatures` text, `invoiceTotal` decimal(12,2), `totalDiscount` decimal(12,2), `chargeTotalTax` decimal(12,2), `chargeTotalCharge` decimal(12,2), `creditAmount` decimal(12,2), `creditComplete` tinyint(1), `creditDays` int(11), `payMethod` varchar(50), `chequeNo` varchar(100), `cardNo` varchar(20), `payment` text, `splitPayment` text, `loyaltyPoints` int(11), `invoiceDate` date, `invoiceTime` time, `customizeTime` time, `startDateTime` datetime, `startTime` time, `endTime` time, `cashierName` varchar(100), `empId` varchar(50), `tableCode` varchar(50), `orderType` varchar(50), `pickupDetails` text, `billNote` text, `channel` varchar(50), `location_id` int(11))
Table `locations`: (`location_id` int(11), `location_name` varchar(100), `address` text, `licenceKey` varchar(100), `created_at` timestamp, `updated_at` timestamp)
Table `products`: (`itemCode` varchar(50), `name` varchar(255), `category` varchar(100), `basePrice` decimal(12,2), `baseCost` decimal(12,2), `created_at` timestamp, `updated_at` timestamp)

Relationships:
  employees.location_id → locations.location_id
  inventory_logs.itemCode → products.itemCode
  inventory_logs.location_id → locations.location_id
  invoices.customerId → customers.customerId
  invoices.empId → employees.empId
  invoices.location_id → locations.location_id
  invoice_items.invoiceNumber → invoices.invoiceNumber
  invoice_items.itemCode → products.itemCode
